correctness.rationale: In characteristic 5, f(x)=x^{2g+1}+x for g=3^r has squarefree derivative at roots because 5∤2g. The Cartier–Manin matrix from f²=x²+2x^(2g+2)+x^(4g+2) has at most one nonzero entry per row/column, following odd labels t=2i−1 under multiplication by 5 modulo 4g. Consequently stable p-rank equals number of full cycles confined to odd labels below 2g, not one-step matrix rank. For v_3(t)=k, the 5-action on units mod 3^(r−k) has full order 2·3^(r−k−1); if r−k≥2, each fixed-mod-4 orbit includes labels above the cutoff. For r−k=1 exactly two labels t=3^(r−1),5·3^(r−1) survive, and v_3(t)=r contributes t=3^r. Thus exactly three labels survive for all r≥1. Independent exact partial-permutation computations r=1..5 reproduced ranks 3 with the specified survivor sets; they corroborate rather than prove the all-r orbit calculation.
residual_risks: Only geometric 5-rank for the given prime-power tower; no Newton polygon, full EO type or zeta function.
The bounded checks are supplementary and do not replace the general mathematical proof.

value.rationale: Geometric p-rank measures the étale p-torsion of Jacobians and is distinct from a-number. A natural exponent subfamily of known hyperelliptic curves has unbounded genus yet fixed positive p-rank three; this exact stable-Cartier classification is a motivated new arithmetic invariant, not a mere restatement of one-step Cartier ranks.
